title: About Me
content: Welcome to my portfolio. I'm a passionate developer and designer focused on creating engaging digital experiences. With expertise in game development, web design, and interactive media, I bring ideas to life through code and creativity.

sections.heading: Experience
sections.text: I have several years of experience in the digital industry, working on projects ranging from indie games to commercial web applications. I specialize in full-stack development and user-centered design.

sections.heading: Skills
sections.text: Game Development, Web Development, UI/UX Design, Creative Coding, 3D Graphics, Animation, and more. I work with various technologies and continuously expand my skillset.

sections.heading: Approach
sections.text: I believe in creating meaningful digital experiences that engage users and solve real problems. Every project is an opportunity to learn and push creative boundaries.
